result.reason: The redline successfully provides a 12-month Software conformance period and removes the fixed sunset, but it does not reach either complete position. It omits the professional-and-workmanlike Services warranty, general Deliverables coverage, and compliance-with-laws warranty; narrows the malicious-code warranty; and provides only commercially reasonable correction efforts rather than a firm repair obligation. It also applies the 12-month period to the MarketSite.net Service using Software acceptance as the trigger, rather than separately addressing the required Services period. The changes do not appear to disturb unrelated commercial terms or introduce a direct contradiction.
